translations.web: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
translations.bsb: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead; He will crush the leaders far and wide.
translations.kjv: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
translations.asv: He will judge among the nations, He will fill the places with dead bodies; He will strike through the head in many countries.
